Our Story

A Contractor Built On Engineering Discipline

Founded on a simple principle - do the work properly the first time - Sharma Interior Construction has grown into a full-service contractor delivering across residential, commercial, industrial and infrastructure sectors.

  • Directly employed supervision on every site
  • Vetted subcontractor panel with performance scoring
  • Defect liability support after handover

Safety & Quality

Our Commitment On Site

Every site runs to a written plan. Every material batch has a record. Every stage is inspected before it is covered up.

  • Site-specific HSE plan issued before mobilisation
  • Daily toolbox talks and mandatory site induction
  • Third-party testing for concrete, steel and soil
  • Stage-wise QA sign-off before the next trade starts
  • Full O&M manuals and as-built drawings at handover
